deviation: The draft makes liability unlimited for both parties (11.1) instead of a 1x annual fees cap, exposing Arcadia to uncapped liability beyond the permitted carve-outs (fraud, IP indemnity, confidentiality). Clause 11.4 also lets the Supplier exclude liability broadly (including for any Section 17 event) and 11.5 shortens the claim period to two years, so the protection is one-sided in the Supplier's favour while Arcadia's own exposure is uncapped.
suggested_text: 11.1 Each party's total aggregate liability arising under or in connection with this Agreement, whether in contract, tort (including negligence), breach of statutory duty or otherwise, shall not exceed 1 times the annual fees paid or payable. 11.2 Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes either party's liability for (a) fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation; (b) the IP infringement indemnity; (c) breach of confidentiality; or (d) any other liability that cannot be limited or excluded by law. 11.3 Each party shall take reasonable steps to mitigate any loss for which it claims against the other. [Delete 11.4 and 11.5, or limit 11.4 to loss to the extent directly caused by the Customer's breach of this Agreement, and delete the two-year claim bar so statutory limitation periods apply.]
